description: Repairs r-par-1/fold-decimal-avg-var-forms: the CDec forms failed and the witnesses were not stored. Asks what Avg, Var and StDev return over FD0 and FD20 per group, what Min, Max and Count give as GROUP BY g, and what Sum(x * 1), Sum(CCur(x)) and Sum(CDbl(x)) give per group, each its own statement. CDec is not used. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.

SELECT Var(x) AS v, StDev(x) AS sd FROM FD0 WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(x * 1) AS s FROM FD0 WHERE g = 1

SELECT Sum(CDbl(x)) AS s FROM FD0 WHERE g = 1
